note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Great Divide district) campground beside 3,227-acre Namekagon Lake, about 20 minutes north-east of Hayward, with a sandy swim beach, boat landing, fishing pier and picnic shelter at the day-use area. The Namekagon Trail loop starts across the road; off-road vehicles must stay on their trailer in the campground. --Claude
summary: rec.gov + FS read: 34 sites (1-11 non-electric, 12-34 15/30/50 electric), vault toilets, hand-pump water, no dump; $18/$28; May 1-Oct 31 (manual, matches); 25 reservable on rec.gov, 9 first-come (FS lists 20 reservable); 14-night max; rig limits to 55 ft. Lakeview kept: nearest sites (017, 019, 014) are ~20-50 m from the lake under continuous canopy. Pin matches the FS point. Phone: FS Hayward office 715-638-7243 vs stored 715-264-2511.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakeview kept. Plotted rec.gov site points on Esri imagery: the south loop's 017 (46.24257,-91.08553) and 019 sit ~20-25 m from the shore and 014/016 ~45-55 m, all under continuous hardwood/hemlock canopy; 001-011 face a marshy bay through trees. No site over open ground at the water, so no upgrade; the beach and fishing pier are day use.
PHONE: stored 715-264-2511 (one of the two numbers recreation.gov lists) -> 715-638-7243 (the Hayward Office, the contact the Forest Service's own page gives for this campground).
WEBSITE: both stored links live - keep (https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/233760 ; https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/chequamegon-nicolet/recreation/namekagon-lake-recreation-area).

BOOKING: recreation.gov's catalog marks 25 of the 34 standard sites reservable; the FS page lists 20 (2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10, 12, 14, 15, 17, 20, 22, 24, 25, 28, 30, 31, 33, 34) - rec.gov additionally sells 013, 016, 018, 019 (trust rec.gov). Reservations close 4 days before arrival (rec.gov reservationCutOff); fcfs kept at some_sites since 9 sites are never reservable.
SITES: max_rig_ft 45 -> 55 (rec.gov Max Vehicle Length 55 on sites 002 and 006); stored note's '10 nonelectric + 24 electric' -> 11 + 23 (catalog). FS gives 45+ ft for most sites.
STATUS: FS page shows 'Site Closed ... closed for the season' (normal off-season, not a closure).
SEASON (manual): May 1 - Oct 31 confirmed on the FS page.

OHV: rec.gov says the campground is 'conveniently located near off-highway vehicle ... trails' and requires off-road vehicles to stay trailered in camp - a general lakeside campground, not an OHV staging camp.

PIN: stored 46.2439,-91.0852 matches the FS point (46.24391,-91.08522) and the site cluster (catalog centroid 46.2441,-91.0856). recreation.gov's facility point 46.3503,-90.9236 is ~17 km off and wrong.
